'''Grenal''' was the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] chief security officer of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]. He gained the prestigious title of [[Spearmaster]] shortly after his arrival on Neftali and was the tribal and spiritual leader of his people on that planet.

The Whiphid [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] was one of the most successful hunters on Neftali and was consequently in high demand as a guide.
